mapper.select: SELECT t.issued_ticket_id, t.ticket_number, t.status, t.valid_from, t.valid_until, t.used_at, ri.product_name, ri.option_name, ri.usage_date, r.status AS reservation_status FROM issued_tickets t JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_item_id = t.reservation_item_id JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = ri.reservation_id WHERE t.verification_token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE OF t
mapper.update: UPDATE issued_tickets SET status = 'USED', used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE issued_ticket_id = #{issuedTicketId} AND status = 'ISSUED'
